week_note: PayCal's stored week recalculation groups hours Sunday through Saturday, matching Work::processWorkWeekContainingDate. Several statutes define the work week differently (Alberta's default is Saturday midnight to Saturday midnight; British Columbia's overtime week is Sunday to Saturday; the Canada Labour Code week is Saturday midnight to the next Saturday midnight). Thresholds below are applied to the week PayCal already uses. Averaging agreements and industry permits are recorded as exceptions and are not applied unless a caller supplies a different rule.

LEGACY.name: PayCal historical default
LEGACY.exceptions: Not a statutory rule. Used only when no province, territory, or federal code is supplied, so existing callers keep the previous 8-hour day and 40-hour week calculation.

CA.name: Federally regulated
CA.source_title: Hours of work - Federally regulated workplaces
CA.statute: Canada Labour Code, RSC 1985, c L-2, ss. 169 and 174. Consolidation current to 2026-09-21.
CA.exceptions: Greater of daily excess over 8 and weekly excess over 40. Reduce the weekly standard by 8 per general holiday. Modified schedules and industry regulations require separate treatment.

AB.name: Alberta
AB.source_title: Employment standards rules – Overtime hours and overtime pay
AB.statute: Employment Standards Code, RSA 2000, c E-9, ss. 21 and 22 (continued from 1996 cE-10.3 s. 21).
AB.exceptions: Greater of daily excess over 8 and weekly excess over 44. Written banking, averaging and occupation exceptions apply.

BC.name: British Columbia
BC.source_title: Employment Standards Act, s. 40 — overtime wages
BC.statute: Employment Standards Act, RSBC 1996, c 113, ss. 35, 37, and 40. Section 40 interpretive guide last updated 2022-10-31.
BC.exceptions: Daily 1.5 times after 8 through 12, double after 12. Weekly 1.5 times after 40, counting only the first 8 hours per day. Section 37 averaging and regulation exclusions differ.

MB.name: Manitoba
MB.source_title: Manitoba Employment Standards fact sheet — Overtime
MB.statute: The Employment Standards Code, CCSM c E110.
MB.exceptions: Daily excess over 8, then weekly excess over 40 without counting daily overtime twice. Paid general holiday leave counts as normal hours. Averaging, flex time and occupation exceptions apply.

NB.name: New Brunswick
NB.statute: Employment Standards Act, SNB, overtime after 44 hours in a work week.
NB.exceptions: Weekly excess over 44. Statutory minimum overtime uses 1.5 times minimum wage, not the regular wage. April 1, 2026 minimum overtime is $23.85. Higher contractual pay and wage orders require their own inputs.

NL.name: Newfoundland and Labrador
NL.statute: Labour Standards Act, RSNL 1990, c L-2.
NL.exceptions: Weekly excess over 40. Statutory minimum overtime is based on minimum wage. From April 1, 2026 the published minimum overtime rate is $24.53. A contract may provide more.

NS.name: Nova Scotia
NS.exceptions: Weekly excess over 48 at 1.5 times regular wages. Occupational wage orders can instead use minimum wage or other rules.

NT.name: Northwest Territories
NT.exceptions: Daily excess over 8, weekly after 40 regular hours. A qualifying holiday week has a 32 regular hour standard; holiday payment is separate. Orders can modify hours.

NU.name: Nunavut
NU.statute: Labour Standards Act, RSNWT (Nu) 1988, c L-1.
NU.exceptions: Daily excess over 8 and weekly after 40 regular hours. Section 11(3) reduces a qualifying holiday week to 32 and excludes holiday work. Permits can modify the standard.

ON.name: Ontario
ON.source_title: Overtime pay | Your guide to the Employment Standards Act
ON.statute: Employment Standards Act, 2000, SO 2000, c 41, s. 22. The Act came into force on 2001-09-04.
ON.exceptions: Weekly excess over 44 at 1.5 times regular wages. No general daily overtime. Averaging, managers, special occupations and the mixed work rule can alter eligibility.

PE.name: Prince Edward Island
PE.statute: Employment Standards Act, RSPEI 1988, c E-6.2.
PE.exceptions: From June 30, 2026: weekly excess over 44 at 1.5 times regular wages. Previously 48. Exemption orders and written averaging apply.

QC.name: Quebec
QC.statute: Act respecting labour standards, CQLR c N-1.1.
QC.exceptions: Generally weekly excess over 40 at 1.5 times regular wages, excluding shift premiums. Paid vacation and qualifying statutory leave hours count for overtime. Occupational standard weeks and exemptions differ.

SK.name: Saskatchewan
SK.source_title: Overtime in a day versus overtime in a week
SK.statute: The Saskatchewan Employment Act, SS 2013, c S-15.1.
SK.exceptions: Greater of daily and weekly overtime at 1.5 times. Standard schedule is five 8 hour days or four 10 hour days. A public holiday week has 32 hours excluding work on the holiday. Modified work arrangements and permits can differ.

YT.name: Yukon
YT.exceptions: Daily excess over 8, then weekly after 40 excluding daily overtime. Section 8(2) reduces the weekly standard by 8 per qualifying holiday and excludes holiday work. Averaging and short week agreements can differ.
